purpose: Teach: コミットメント/印刷物/公職/増産/ふさわしく/簡略/お買い得/取り直し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、コミットメント、絶対、社員、絶対、心に、絶対、響いたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In the founding years, your father had absolute commitment — it truly resonated with the staff's hearts. I'm asking you to carry that forward.
lines.style: Measured, respectful tone. Slow, deliberate pacing. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. The voice of someone looking backward with clarity, not nostalgia. Pause slightly before "I'm asking" — a gentle but serious responsibility being passed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、印刷物、絶対、品質、絶対、こだわってまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's time, we have been absolutely committed to the quality of our printed materials. I'm grateful for that legacy.
lines.style: Steady, formal register. Respectful cadence, not rushed. Clear enunciation on "quality." A promise being renewed rather than merely acknowledged. Slight warmth beneath the professional tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの代、本気で、絶対、公職、絶対、推薦された方々、絶対、お招き、絶対、してきたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father's generation invited people of distinction from the public sector — he brought them into the fold. That mattered.
lines.style: Quieter, reflective. A touch of wistfulness on "invited" — remembering a time and a way of building relationships. Steady eye contact in the voice. Trailing slightly at the end, as if seeing the past clearly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、増産、絶対、需要に応じてきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's time, we have scaled production responsively to meet demand. For that stewardship, I'm grateful.
lines.style: Deliberate, measured pacing. "Scaled" and "demand" each carry weight. The voice of someone acknowledging continuity with respect. Not reciting — speaking from lived understanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、業界に、絶対、ふさわしく、絶対、お振る舞い、絶対、できる方だったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father was a man of absolute propriety — he knew exactly how to conduct himself in this industry. That was rare.
lines.style: Warm, admiring tone. Slight emphasis on "propriety" and "conduct" — words chosen with care. A pause before the final sentence. Voice carries both respect and a touch of personal affection for the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの教えで、本気で、絶対、業務の、絶対、簡略、絶対、化、絶対、進めてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Your father taught us to streamline our operations — to make things simpler and more direct. I carry that teaching with me.
lines.style: Gentle, sincere delivery. "Streamline" spoken with quiet conviction. A slight catch of personal warmth on "I carry that teaching" — not just corporate practice, but something internalized. Thoughtful pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの時代、本気で、絶対、お買い得、絶対、仕入れ、絶対、自分で、絶対、足を運んだぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In your father's day, he walked the markets himself to find the best deals — he didn't delegate that work.
lines.style: Admiring, with a hint of wistfulness. Emphasis on "himself" and "walked" — concrete action, not abstraction. Slow cadence. Voice carries both respect and the weight of knowing that kind of dedication is less common now.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、取り直し、絶対、必要な時、絶対、誠実に、絶対、対応してまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since your father's time, whenever we've needed to redo something, we've handled it with honesty and care. That's the standard he set.
lines.style: Quiet, composed delivery. Emphasis on "honesty" and "care" — not just efficiency, but values. A sense of closure and continuity. Voice steady and clear, like a promise being restated. Slight pause at the end.
